legalDraft.text: These pages set out how Cargado Strategies works, how it handles your information and what its partners agree to. They are general information, not legal advice.

Some services on this website are provided by Cargado Strategies directly, not by a partner: insurance, business strategy, outsourcing, web design, graphics, virtual assistance, software development, export and import, and contractor services (homecare cleaning, roofing, cleaning and gardening). They are labelled “Ours” and operate under their own licences where a licence applies. Licence details are provided on request and before any application.

Cargado Strategies may receive a commission from a partner when a referral becomes a client. You never pay Cargado Strategies for an introduction, and it discloses the commission on partner profiles, finder results and the inquiry form.
Insurance inquiries continue on a separate policy review website. Information you give there is handled under that website's own terms.

Information CollectedYour name, email address, phone or WhatsApp number, city or area, and the message you send. When you book a consultation, also the time you choose, the service it is about and your note. When you create an account, also your profile, bookings, points history and any referral code. When you apply as a partner, the details in your application.

Why It Is CollectedTo answer your inquiry, book your consultation, run your account and points, review partner applications, and connect you with a suitable partner. Cargado Strategies asks for your city so that it can find someone close to you.
Who Sees ItCargado staff and the partner you are connected with. Cargado Strategies does not sell your information.

Where It Is KeptIn Cargado Strategies' lead records and with the services that run this website: Google Firebase (accounts, sign-in, and records of profiles, bookings, points, referrals and partner applications), Google Calendar and Google Meet (consultation bookings and meeting links) and Resend (confirmation emails). These services may store information outside Canada. Facebook and WhatsApp apply their own terms to messages sent through them.

How Long It Is KeptCargado Strategies keeps your information for up to 24 months after its last contact with you, or while your account stays open, unless the law requires it to be kept longer. Then it is deleted securely.

Your RightsYou may ask to see, correct or delete your information, or close your account, and you may withdraw consent at any time. Contact Lee Holgado at info@cargadostrategies.com, and Cargado Strategies will respond within 30 days. It follows the privacy laws that apply in Canada and in your province.

MessagesCargado Strategies sends you messages only with your consent, and each marketing message includes a way to unsubscribe. Booking confirmations and account emails are sent only because you asked for them.

Cookies and AnalyticsCargado Strategies uses no advertising cookies and no analytics tools. Your browser keeps a few small settings on your own device, which Cargado Strategies cannot see. When you sign in, Firebase also keeps your sign-in state on your device so you stay signed in.

Accounts and Sign-InYou can create an account with an email address and password, or continue with Google, in which case Google shares your name and email address with Cargado Strategies. Passwords are handled by Firebase and are never visible to Cargado Strategies.
ChangesCargado Strategies may change the website and these terms at any time. The latest version applies when you use the website.

ConsultationsA free consultation is a 10-minute Google Meet call, booked in Central Time. It does not create a professional relationship, and prices for Cargado Strategies' own services are quoted only after it. Cargado Strategies may confirm, move or cancel a booking by email.

Accounts and PointsSigned-in clients earn 5 points for each qualifying event: a completed consultation they booked, a service they acquire from Cargado Strategies, and a friend who signs up with their referral link and completes a first consultation. Each event counts once. Points have no cash value and cannot yet be spent. Cargado Strategies may correct points awarded in error and may close an account that is misused.
Partners may pay Cargado Strategies a fee if you become their client. You never pay Cargado Strategies for an introduction.

Because Cargado Strategies may receive a commission, it says so on partner profiles, finder results and the inquiry form. Partners set their own fees and explain any fee or commission before work begins.

Cargado Strategies uses your name, contact details, city or area and your message to answer you and connect you with a partner close to you. It asks for your city only to find someone near you. Cargado staff and the partner you are connected with see it, and Cargado Strategies does not sell it.

Cargado Strategies' own services (insurance, business strategy, outsourcing, web design, graphics, virtual assistance, software development, export and import, and contractor services) are labelled “Ours”. Its strategy service is strategy and coaching only — not licensed accounting, tax or investment advice.
Once an application is approved, Cargado Strategies emails an invitation to sign up with the email address in it. That account then opens the partner dashboard.
